description: List every catalog category, with no filters, in first-seen catalog order. Use this to get valid category names before calling search_tools with a category filter. It does not list tools; omit query on search_tools for the full tool catalog, and use get_tool only when you already have a slug. No authentication. The list is unpaginated and complete. This server allows 60 MCP requests per minute.
name: list_categories

categories.description: Unique category names in first-seen catalog order, suitable for search_tools category.

count.description: Number of categories; equals categories.length. There is no pagination.

title: List categories
